claim: In the llmapper NBlood fork, -bot without -bot_visible draws no frame and runs the game clock as fast as it can; -bot_trajectory writes the player's x/y/z and sector each tick. That run takes no window from the desktop and its per-tick sector is a better readout than any screenshot.
evidence: NBlood/source/blood/src/blood.cpp:2008 (bot Fast: totalclock = gNetFifoClock), :2066 (bDraw only when Visible), :1275/:1278 (flags).
The owner, 2026-08-31: run NBlood 'only ... completely in background'.
use: Run the engine only with -bot hidden, through a background process; read the trajectory.
